scope: Automatic original-HDF5 to exact runtime-rANS residency and seven-acquisition interaction

seven_hdf5_to_resident_seconds.cache_state: operating-system source pages unspecified; not cold I/O

parity.independent_source_check_policy: six scan positions per acquisition, including block boundaries and rare 65535 counts
parity.full_volume_sha256: not run; selected-position parity is not a complete-volume audit

candidates.name: smaller source windows
candidates.result: 32768 scans was fastest at 2.67 s for one warm source; 4096, 8192 and 16384 took 3.52, 2.77 and 2.69 s

candidates.name: threadgroup subtotal reduction
candidates.result: p95 worsened from 11.82 ms to 12.69-13.21 ms

candidates.name: two entropy streams per lane
candidates.result: p50/p95 did not improve in paired exact trials

candidates.name: partial-image reduction
candidates.result: no p95 gain and a full ADF seed could reserve about 591 MB scratch

candidates.name: explicit Metal residency set
candidates.result: priority DP p95 improved from 22.80 ms with residency stalls to 2.56 ms without a separate warm-up

candidates.name: hoist common entropy model dispatch
candidates.result: wide ADF p95 improved from 11.81 ms to 8.84 ms; strict 8.33 ms p95 target remains unmet

qualification.automatic_hdf5_to_ans_backend: implemented and focused parity-tested on physical MPS
qualification.native_live4dstem_integration: not implemented; Python MPS backend evidence is not native-app acceptance
